question: The control of the acid-peptic disease is mainly achieved with PPIs (proton pump inhibitors). The PPIs:

options.opa: They induce the maximum inhibition of gastric secretion after 3-5 days.
options.opb: They are less effective than H-2 antagonists.
options.opc: They are used as monotherapy to eradicate Helicobacter pylori.
options.opd: They have a faster onset of action than H-2 antagonists.
options.ope: They are not useful in the treatment of stress ulcers.
